run_benchmark_file_generator: run the generate.py script to produce benchmark C++ files from templates in a source directory
generate_random_boost_metaparse_string: create a random BOOST_METAPARSE_STRING macro call with a given length of random characters
convert_boost_string_to_manual: convert BOOST_METAPARSE_STRING macros in source code to manual boost::metaparse::string template syntax
instantiate_cpp_template_with_n: instantiate a Cheetah-based C++ template file by substituting the variable N with a numeric value
parse_template_properties_from_comments: extract properties like modes, range, and description from C++ template comment annotations
